title: Time Blindness Challenge
description: Three-round self-measurement of felt time versus actual time - interval waiting among distractors, duration judgment of an engaging task, and prediction of a repeat - with signed-error ledger and a visible-clock toggle demonstrating externalized time as the fix.
creator: Arun Batchu
subject: ADHD
Time Blindness
Time Perception
Time Estimation
audience: People with ADHD, Family members, Students, Educators

controls.label: Visible clock
controls.purpose: Externalize time during the task rounds
